'''Eric Bissot''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 Tierfon Con I]] on 4 November 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1423">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-brugges-belgium-04-11-2000d1423/ brugges-belgium-04-11-2000], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-brugges-belgium-04-11-2000d1423/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
